messages:
Rina (Finance): Following up on the metering postmortem. Summary: delayed ingestion + dedupe mismatch produced a ledger delta (~1.1M tokens) that hit a subset of usage invoices. Need: invoice hold, canonical affected list, backfill validation, customer comms, and a signed-off credit run. Assign owners?
Darren (Billing Eng): I'll own the backfill validation + credit staging. Plan: compute per-account delta, stage credits to a review ledger, and expose a review dashboard. Need a safe flag to prevent auto-posting.
Priya (SRE): I'll take pipeline containment and replay orchestration. Suggest: pause source connector, run replay in staging with `--dedupe-key=event_fingerprint`, compare outputs to current ledger, then timeline a night-window cutover.
Omar (RevOps): I'll handle invoice tagging and blocking autopay. Create tag `pending-correction-2026-06` and ensure accounting doesn't run collections for those invoices. Will produce the invoice CSV once we have canonical account_id list.
Hannah (Customer Success): I'll draft customer messages and coordinate with Legal for wording. We should segment customers: top-N by $ impact get personalized outreach. Rest get templated email.
Rina (Finance): Owners: Darren=backfill, Priya=containment, Omar=invoices, Hannah=comms. Please confirm ETAs and add checklist items to ticket 7401.
Darren (Billing Eng): ETA for initial delta table and staging flow: 36h. Quick SQL to pull deltas: ```sql
WITH late AS (
  SELECT account_id, SUM(tokens) AS late_tokens
  FROM ingestion_events
  WHERE arrived_at > ledger_watermark
  GROUP BY account_id
)
SELECT l.account_id, l.late_tokens, COALESCE(t.posted_tokens,0) AS posted
FROM late l
LEFT JOIN ledger_totals t ON t.account_id = l.account_id;
```
Priya (SRE): Containment checklist by EOD: 1) pause connector `partner-bridge`, 2) enable staging replay, 3) run dry-run with sample accounts, 4) snapshot watermark. I'll post logs to the ticket.
Omar (RevOps): Will prepare the invoice-block workflow in 8 hours. Need confirmation on which billing cycles to include (pro-rate monthly vs usage).
Hannah (Customer Success): I'll prepare two templates: high-touch and bulk. Legal: can you review tone and required disclaimers?
notify-bot: Ticket 7401 created by Priya. Link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/7401. Checklist fields: owner=unassigned, status=open.
Rina (Finance): Two timeline asks: (A) provisional credits staged within 7 business days, (B) final posting within 14 business days after validation. Can team commit?
Darren (Billing Eng): 7/14 looks reasonable if staging and sample verification pass. I'll run manual checks for top 25 accounts before posting.
Priya (SRE): I'll add an alert metric `late_ingest_ratio` and a Grafana panel. Monitor: alert if ratio > 0.3% over rolling 2h window -> auto-pause and create incident.
Omar (RevOps): I'll also flag partner reports and revenue dashboards so FP&A doesn't see transient spikes.
Hannah (Customer Success): Comms cadence: heads-up within 48h of canonical list, validation update after dry-run, final correction notice when credits posted. I'll attach templates to 7401/docs/comms.
Rina (Finance): Please ensure all artifacts (query, replay logs, staged-credit ledger export, comms drafts) are uploaded to 7401. We'll do an exec summary after the 48h verification sync.
Darren (Billing Eng): Added PR #912 (staged-credit flow) and checklist to 7401.
Priya (SRE): Dry-run scheduled for 2026-06-16T01:00Z. Will post results to ticket and call for a quick review if anything deviates.
